summary: The analyzed niche is dominated by competitors leveraging 100% Sidecar posts paired with automated DM-funnel CTAs ("Comment LINK") to drive massive engagement. Competitors like @manly.looks and @luxeryclubindia generate thousands of comments per post by gating product links behind a follow-and-comment gate, whereas the creator (@trendstrykarle) is posting single fashion lists with zero interactive CTA, resulting in negligible engagement.
topPerformerInsights: 100% of analyzed competitor posts across @_esthetic.whispers, @manly.looks, and @luxeryclubindia utilize the [Sidecar] post format.

Competitors exclusively use automated comment-to-DM triggers in their captions, such as "Follow & Comment 'LINK' to get links", driving extreme comment volumes (averaging 1,160 to 11,605 comments per post).

@_esthetic.whispers successfully enforces a conditional gate in Hinglish ("Follow karoge tabhi link aayega, warna DM nahi aayega!") to simultaneously boost follower growth and algorithmic comment signals.

@manly.looks achieves massive scale (avg ~196k likes, ~11.6k comments) by pairing high-intent men's fashion sidecars (denim, linen pants, trackpants starting at ₹199) with explicit pricing and product category callouts.
ownAccountGaps: The creator (@trendstrykarle) has only published 1 post, suffering from low visibility with just 61 likes and 2 comments.
The creator's single post uses a text-heavy educational format ("5 SHIRT COLORS EVERY MAN SHOULD OWN 👔") instead of the high-converting shoppable [Sidecar] lookbooks used by competitors.
The creator's caption cuts off mid-sentence ("endless outf") and completely lacks a DM automation CTA (like "Comment LINK"), missing out on the primary engagement driver of the niche.
Unlike top competitor @manly.looks, the creator's post fails to feature specific product hooks, pricing details, or direct shopping intent that prompt users to type a keyword in the comments.
recommendations: Immediately pivot the content format to 100% [Sidecar] photo carousels showcasing curated men's outfits, matching the proven style of @manly.looks.

Integrate an automated comment-to-DM keyword trigger on every post (e.g., "Follow & Comment 'LINK' to get the outfit links"), mirroring the high-converting caption architecture of all three competitors.
Add explicit value markers and pricing hooks to captions and slides (e.g., "Trendy Denim Jeans Starting ₹199/-") to stimulate high-intent comment behavior.
Publish consistently to build up baseline account authority, closing the volume gap against competitors who maintain active grids of 30+ optimized posts.
Use strict follow-gating text in the caption (e.g., requiring users to follow before the DM automation triggers the link) to convert high comment volume into net-new followers.
